title: Kylie Flash Dash
subject: Kylie's after-party escape
subtitle: The runway was the easy part. Get to the party without three more photos.
description: A tiny camera-dodging game inspired by the conversation around Kylie Jenner's October 2026 runway appearance. Collect three passes and escape to the after-party.
